g.text: Owns lifecycle status writes end to end
None/None on a first run — never
Failure here fails the run at stage
Recorded even for a rejected candidate,
A cleanup failure can never affect
Only after the ENTIRE sequence — training
A HARD PROCESS KILL LOSES THE THREAD SILENTLY
The MongoDB lock makes this safe ACROSS processes, but within one
process this is an ordinary daemon Thread — a kill mid-run leaves no
in-process trace; ML-FLOW-08's startup sweep is the only recovery…

svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Absent mechanisms are named in a note, never drawn as implemented steps.
Documented as the umbrella lifecycle per the rules — does not replace the independent FLOW-03..06 detail.
